_notice: DEMO routing table. The agencies are the real ones responsible in São Paulo, but the e-mail addresses are fictitious (.invalid domain) and no letter is actually sent: the .eml files stay in src/data/runtime/letters.

damaged_sidewalk.legal_basis: São Paulo Municipal Law 15,442/2011 (sidewalks) and ABNT NBR 9050:2020 (Brazilian accessibility standard), item 6.12

sidewalk_obstruction.legal_basis: Brazilian Traffic Code (CTB) art. 181, VIII (parking on the sidewalk) and Municipal Law 15,442/2011

ramp_access.agency: Municipal Secretariat for Persons with Disabilities (SMPED) + Subprefecture
ramp_access.legal_basis: Law 13,146/2015 (Brazilian Inclusion Law), art. 53 and ABNT NBR 9050:2020, item 6.6

tactile_paving.agency: Municipal Secretariat for Persons with Disabilities (SMPED)
tactile_paving.legal_basis: ABNT NBR 16537 (tactile floor signage) and Law 10,098/2000

crossing_signal.legal_basis: Brazilian Traffic Code (CTB) arts. 70 and 71 and Law 10,098/2000, art. 9 (audible pedestrian signals)

accessible_transit.agency: SPTrans / Metro / CPTM (depending on the mode)
